# Menards

> Menards is a home improvement retailer offering tools, building materials, and hardware with flexible shopping options including online ordering, in-store pickup, and delivery services.

Menards provides a comprehensive home improvement shopping experience with integrated credit programs, financing options, and multiple fulfillment channels. The site features the Menards BIG Card rewards program in partnership with Capital One, enabling customers to earn rewards and access promotional financing.

## Key Topics

- Menards BIG Card
- Capital One financing
- Buy online pickup in store
- Home improvement
- Rewards program
- Rebates
- Store delivery
- Menards app
- Credit programs
- Promotional offers
- Account management
- In-store pickup
- APR financing
- JavaScript enabled browsing
- Cookies and browser settings

- [Buy Online & Pick Up at Store](https://www.menards.com/main/buy-online-pick-up-at-store/c-12969.htm): Guide to online ordering and in-store pickup service at Menards
- [Store Delivery Information](https://www.menards.com/main/store-delivery-information/c-19472.htm): Delivery options, requirements, and installation services information

## Credit & Financing

- [Menards BIG Card](https://www.menards.com/main/menards-credit-programs/menards-big-card/c-14304.htm): Menards BIG Card credit program with rewards and financing options
